testimonials.title: Okushiwo Amakhasimende
testimonials.subtitle: Impendulo yangempela evela emakhasimendeni angempela — ibuyekezwa njengoba ama-oda eqedwa.
testimonials.emptyDesc: Le ngxenye izokhombisa ukubuyekezwa kwamakhasimende angempela njengoba ama-oda eqedwa. Yiba omunye wamakhasimende ethu okuqala — sithumele umlayezo ukuze siqale.

items.a: Sithumele umlayezo ku-WhatsApp ngomkhiqizo owufunayo. Sizobuza imibuzo embalwa bese siqala ukuthola izimpahla ngokushesha.
Yebo — sihlela amasampula akhokhelwayo ukuze uhlole ikhwalithi ngaphambi kokwenza i-oda elikhulu.
Sisebenzisa inqubo yenkokhelo ehlelekile, isigaba ngesigaba, ukuze imali ikhishwe kuphela lapho izigaba ezivunyelwene zifezekile.
Yebo, i-oda ngalinye lidlula ekuhlolweni kwemikhiqizo ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa ukuthunyelwa.
Sinikeza ukuthunyelwa kwamaphakethe amancane samasampula nama-oda amancane, kanye nokuthunyelwa okugcwele kusuka emnyango kuya emnyango kwama-oda amakhulu.
Njengamanje sithumela kusuka e-China nase-Hong Kong siye e-Hong Kong, e-India, nase-South Africa, izifunda ezengeziwe ziyongezwa.

about.title: Sihlanganisa Nawe Namafektri Ainhle eChina
about.subtitle: Sakha ibhuloho phakathi kwabathengi basezingxenyeni zomhlaba nabahlinzeki abaqinisekisiwe beChina — ngokucacile, ukuhlola nokwethenjwa kuwo wonke umzuzwana.
about.story: The Unique Choice idalwe ukuxazulula inkinga elula: ukuthola izimpahla eChina akufanele kudinge i-bhuleki noma uthembe. Sakha inethiwekhi yabahlinzeki abaqinisekisiwe emazweni amakhulu eChina ne-Hong Kong, sihlanganise nokuhlola, futhi sisigqokele inqubo ecacile.
about.mission: Umsebenzi wethu ukwenza ukuthola izimpahla zomhlaba kube lula, kuphephile futhi kusebenze kalula kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwebhizinisi — kusukela kubathengi abasha kuya kumabhrendi aqinile.
